freePlan.limits: 1 chart per tab, 2 indicators per chart, 5,000 historical bars, 3 price alerts.

keyLimits.en: 1 chart per tab, 2 indicators per chart, 5,000 historical bars, 2 parallel chart connections, 3 price alerts.
2 charts per tab, 5 indicators, 10,000 historical bars, 20 price alerts, 20 technical alerts.
4 charts per tab, 10 indicators, 10,000 historical bars, 100 price alerts.
8 charts per tab, 25 indicators, 20,000 historical bars, 400 price alerts, 2 watchlist alerts.
16 charts per tab, 50 indicators, 40,000 historical bars, 1,000 price alerts, 15 watchlist alerts.

cautions.en: Pricing page shows identical monthly and 'annual' per-month rates but frames annual billing as saving a fixed dollar amount per year; the underlying billing cadence difference could not be fully disentangled within budget.

capabilities.en: Real-time and historical stock/crypto/forex charting with technical analysis tools.
Custom price and technical alerts, scaling with plan tier.
Built-in social trading community for sharing charts and ideas.
Multi-chart layouts with an increasing number of simultaneous charts per tier.

limitations.en: Free plan is capped at 1 chart per tab and only 2 indicators, too limited for serious multi-asset analysis.
Historical bar depth (5,000 on Free) restricts long-range backtesting without a paid plan.

unknowns: Whether sales tax is included in the displayed USD prices is not stated ('sales tax may apply by location').
